Select: chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, pref_name AS molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles
Source: docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures
Join: docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id, compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: docs.chembl_id IS 'CHEMBL1150404'
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC
Limit: NULL
